format: The format of tools/balance-program/knobs.mjs on lane/c-balance-matrix: a knob is a multiplier (1 = today) on numbers the game itself reads. Each site picks `count` lines of `file` that hold the text `line`, and on each the number after every `nums` prefix (a regular expression source that must match once on the line. { at, float } keeps a decimal. { all: true } takes every number on the line).

Fields this file adds, which a reader may ignore: `value` (the numbers today, in site and pick order, checked by formulas/architecture-register.mjs --check), `formula` (the id in formulas-architecture.json the knob moves), `ruled` (Tyler ruled today's value on that date: measure with it, do not ship a change without him), `sharesLineWith` (other knobs that pick numbers on the same source line: a patch that moves two of them must apply both picks to the one line).

`planned` are knobs the unified model adds. Each names the roadmap step that creates it and where it will live. They are not playable until that step lands. `notKnobs` are per-ground and compensating numbers that must not be tuned: each is replaced by the knob it names.

knobs.label: Player attack
knobs.what: The hero's largest blow: the skill term, the gear term and the base together. Every basic hit, and every spell, heal, shell and bleed, is a share of it. Splits into skillPower, gearPower and basePower at roadmap step R2 (the planned list)

knobs.label: Critical hit size
knobs.what: A critical basic blow's multiple (COMBAT_BALANCE.critMult). With the 60% chance cap this bounds crit at +30% damage

knobs.label: Weakness bonus
knobs.what: The damage multiple of a weapon a monster is weak to (WEAKNESS_BONUS.damage). Basic blows only today

knobs.label: To-hit base
knobs.what: The flat rating both sides of every to-hit ratio start from (TO_HIT.base). It sets how much one point of skill, accuracy or Defense is worth at low Level. The monsters' aim and evasion are written through it

knobs.label: Player to-hit
knobs.what: The reference hero's chance to land on a same-Level regular, written on every monster as its evasion (STAT_FORMULA.heroHit)

knobs.label: Attack interval
knobs.what: The one basic attack clock for heroes and monsters, in ms (COMBAT_BALANCE.tickMs). RULED 2.0 s on 2026-10-15: a knob to measure with, not to ship without Tyler

knobs.label: Spell roll floor
knobs.what: The low end of a spell hit's roll, permille of its top (ABILITY_RULES.hitLowPm). Swings roll from 1, spells from half: this is the spread of the one roll rule

knobs.label: Mana regeneration
knobs.what: Mana back a minute, percent of max (ABILITY_RULES.manaRegenPctPerMin): casts an hour and drink bought

knobs.label: Store supply strength
knobs.what: What a store heal, drink, arrow or rune gives against its crafted partner (BASIC_EFFECT_SHARE)

knobs.label: Monster damage
knobs.what: A regular's largest blow as a share of a same-Level hero's HP, and the gentle grounds' cap (STAT_FORMULA.blow). All incoming damage, food bought and deaths

knobs.label: Monster HP
knobs.what: A regular's HP line, base and a Level (STAT_FORMULA.hp). Kill time everywhere, and XP and coin a kill, which are priced per HP point

knobs.label: Monster to-hit
knobs.what: A regular's chance to land on the reference hero, gentle and full grounds (STAT_FORMULA.hit)

knobs.label: Monster defense
knobs.what: A regular's defense a Level (STAT_FORMULA.def)

knobs.label: Defense cut a point
knobs.what: The whole points one point of monster defense takes off every blow and tick (COMBAT_BALANCE.monsterDefenseDamageReduction). Small hits against big ones: bleeds, area spells, multi-hit rows

knobs.label: Party ground HP
knobs.what: The HP multiple of a monster on a ground built for a party (STAT_FORMULA.fit.party.hp)

knobs.label: Party ground blow
knobs.what: The blow multiple of a monster on a ground built for a party (STAT_FORMULA.fit.party.blow)

knobs.label: Harder-tier blows
knobs.what: Dangerous and Deadly blows, permille of Normal (TIER_DIALS dmgPm). Today it also moves aim and the Level armor reads (X-TIER-TRIPLE)

knobs.label: Harder-tier HP
knobs.what: Dangerous and Deadly monster HP, permille of Normal (TIER_DIALS hpPm)

knobs.label: Harder-tier XP
knobs.what: Dangerous and Deadly XP a kill, permille of Normal (TIER_DIALS xpPm): the reward half of risk against reward

knobs.label: Harder-tier pull
knobs.what: How many monsters a Dangerous or Deadly fight brings (TIER_DIALS pull). Kill rate, area damage worth, and the damage a tank holds

knobs.label: Hero HP
knobs.what: A hero's HP, base and a Level (VITALS). The monsters' blows are a share of it, so they follow

knobs.label: Hero mana
knobs.what: A hero's mana, base and a Level (VITALS): casts before a drink

knobs.label: Armor mitigation
knobs.what: The most dodge and absorb armor can reach, and ward a point (ARMOUR_MITIGATION)

knobs.label: Armor against Level
knobs.what: How fast a fixed set of armor fades against a higher-Level attacker (ARMOUR_MITIGATION dodge.k and absorb.k). Lower keeps old armor useful longer

knobs.label: Mitigation cap
knobs.what: Dodge, absorb and ward together never take more than this share (ARMOUR_MITIGATION.capPm). RULED 60% on 2026-10-18 (K7). On any gear curve that keeps pace it is the real armor number

knobs.label: Regeneration
knobs.what: HP back a second, in a fight and between fights: downtime and food bought

knobs.label: XP a kill
knobs.what: Level XP a monster HP point pays, and its floor (STAT_FORMULA.xp a and min). Hours a Level everywhere

knobs.label: XP a kill by Level
knobs.what: The power of monster Level in XP a HP point (STAT_FORMULA.xp b). Whether XP a kill outruns the pace line at high Level (0.4 against the contract's 1.274 less kill-HP growth)

knobs.label: Coin a kill
knobs.what: Gold a monster HP point pays (STAT_FORMULA.gp.perHp). Gold in at every Level. The four stacked coin dials fold into this at roadmap step R9

knobs.label: Solo XP bonus
knobs.what: A lone hero's Level XP, permille (SOLO_XP_PM). RULED +15% on 2026-11-11. Folds into the party table as its first cell at roadmap step R8

knobs.label: Party XP table
knobs.what: Every cell of the one party table, permille on the even share (PARTY_CLASS_XP): solo against party

knobs.label: Level XP curve
knobs.what: The Level XP every Level costs (LEVEL_CURVE first and every bracket's rise). A death costs a share of it

knobs.label: Death cost
knobs.what: The share of a hero's Level XP and combat-skill progress a death takes (DEATH_XP_LOSS). RULED 6% flat with no cap on 2026-11-21 (50-4)

knobs.label: Necrotic's heal cut
knobs.what: How much of every heal a Withered hero loses after a Necrotic blow (statuses.js Withered healCutPm.hero: 300 is 30%). Moves nothing while NECROTIC_STORM.live is false: chapter 14's full-game block (patches/ch14-full-game.json) plays it live

knobs.label: Storm's mana burn
knobs.what: The share of the HP a Storm blow takes from a hero that it also burns from the hero's mana (elements.js ELEMENT_ON_HERO.storm.manaBurnPm: 500 is half). Moves nothing while NECROTIC_STORM.live is false: chapter 14's full-game block plays it live

planned.label: Skill term of a blow
planned.home: src/core/combat.js COMBAT_BALANCE.strengthLevelScale, once the blow reads it
planned.what: How much of a hero's hit a trained skill level is worth. Against gearPower it decides skill's share of a hit at every Level

planned.label: Gear term of a blow
planned.home: src/core/combat.js COMBAT_BALANCE.strengthBonusScale
planned.what: How much of a hero's hit a point of weapon damage is worth

planned.label: Base blow
planned.home: src/core/combat.js COMBAT_BALANCE.playerBaseMaxHit
planned.what: The flat part of a hit. It matters only in the first ten Levels

planned.label: Beginner's floor on power
planned.home: src/data/abilities.js ABILITY_RULES
planned.what: A cast never reads a hit under this number. One number in place of a floor on every spell row

planned.label: Rune tier step
planned.today: +10% a tier, five tiers, the last at skill 60
planned.home: src/data/runes.js as a base and a step, not five typed numbers
planned.what: What a rune tier is worth, and whether tiers continue past skill 60

planned.label: Gear curve slope
planned.today: none in the game. Staged: Dawnsteel x Level / 110
planned.home: src/data/gear-curve.js
planned.what: How fast weapon damage and armor points grow with the Level a piece is worn at. Whether hero power and armor keep pace with monsters, forever

planned.label: Gear band width
planned.home: src/data/gear-curve.js
planned.what: How far apart upgrades sit, as a percent of power and not a count of Levels, so an upgrade is worth feeling at Level 2,000

planned.label: Unique exchange rates
planned.today: each unique sized by hand against a simulator at the fourth digit
planned.home: src/data/gear-curve.js
planned.what: How many armor points one point of accuracy, damage, crit or resistance costs. A unique's armor is then arithmetic

planned.label: Pace contract
planned.today: 1385 x L^1.274 Level XP an hour
planned.home: src/data/core-model.js LEVEL_PACE.contract (it exists, and only the judge reads it today)
planned.what: What an hour pays at Level L. After R12 the game derives XP a kill from it, so moving it moves every ground with no re-fit

planned.label: Hours a Level
planned.home: src/data/core-model.js
planned.what: How long each Level takes: a short table to Level 100 and one law after. The Level XP curve is this times the pace contract

planned.label: Skill curve
planned.home: src/data/core-model.js SKILL_CURVE (it exists. The matrix cannot move it until its heroes' skills come from the curve and not from a straight line)
planned.what: How fast skills rise: to-hit, Defense, and the yard's worth

planned.label: Reference kill rate
planned.today: no term. 15 GROUND_XP_FIT and 11 GROUND_GP_FIT numbers stand in for it
planned.home: written by tools/gen-ground-stats.mjs from the matrix, one derived number a ground
planned.what: How many HP points of monster a ground gives up in an hour. It is derived, never typed: listed so nobody tunes the old per-ground numbers

planned.label: Coin line
planned.today: four stacked dials: 0.30 x a floor line 0.5 to 1.4 x party 1.17 or 0.53 x ground 0.7
planned.home: src/data/balance-sheet.js STAT_FORMULA.gp as one line by monster Level
planned.what: Gold a monster HP point pays at each Level, as one line

planned.label: Price in hours of wage
planned.today: six price lines, each straight in Level: refill 1000 + 250 L, Blessing 100 + 10 L, yard, rename, colors, Tempering tables
planned.home: src/data/wage.js, and an hours column on each price row
planned.what: Every repeating price as hours of a lone MID hero's net gold at the buyer's Level

planned.label: Gold a hit point healed
planned.today: five hand prices, 0.19 to 1.75 gold a hit point
planned.home: src/data/supply-basics.js as one line
planned.what: What the store charges to heal a hit point. It sets the supply bill of every harder tier

planned.label: Standing sinks as band gold
planned.today: typed ladders that end at tier 7
planned.home: src/data/temper.js and the other ladders, as a share
planned.what: What a band's standing upgrades cost as a share of the band's net gold. RULED 1.2 to 1.4 on 2026-11-18

planned.label: Sale share a tier
planned.home: src/data/loot-bands.js as share1 x step^(tier-1) / bookClimb^(tier-1)
planned.what: What sold gear pays against its book value: sold-loot income, the market floor and the bench tax

planned.label: Drop band hours
planned.home: src/data/loot-bands.js BAND_TARGETS (it exists) with the chance derived
planned.what: How many hunted hours each kind of drop takes. The chance on each row is derived from the ground's kill rate

planned.label: The cap on "takes more"
planned.today: no cap; CORE-3 proposes +30% in all (0.30)
planned.home: src/core/hunt/damage.js, the sum of Hunter's Mark and the strongest marking status (patches/ch14-full-game.json plants the cap at 300 permille for chapter 14's full-game block)
planned.what: The most a monster can take more from marks and marking statuses together. Element weakness and weapon weakness are separate keys outside it (01-core-and-combat.md, CORE-3, PROVISIONAL)

planned.label: Max mana a Magic level
planned.today: 0.005 with GR-22 (patches/combat-3.json: 5 permille a Magic level, every hero)
planned.home: src/core/vitals.js maxMana, once GR-22 is built and the number is named
planned.what: How much max mana every Magic level adds to any hero. It lives in GR-22's patch until the build names it
